outputs.explanation: Panel A is a western blot image, not a plot of averaged data; individual data points are not applicable.
Panel B contains phase-contrast micrographs, not a plot of averaged data; individual data points are not applicable.

The bottom bar chart (mean ± SEM, n=3) in panel C overlays individual data points (distinct markers per condition) for each replicate; the top density plots are raw representative flow cytometry data, not averaged summaries.
The bottom bar chart (mean ± SD, n=3) shows individual replicate data points overlaid on the bars; the top density plots are raw representative flow cytometry data, not averaged summaries.
Panel E is a heatmap of normalized expression values; heatmaps are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel F is a western blot image, not a plot of averaged data; individual data points are not applicable.
Both bar charts (mean ± SEM, n=3) in panel G display individual replicate data points (dots/triangles) overlaid on the bars for each gene.
Panel H shows representative immunofluorescence micrographs, not a plot of averaged data; individual data points are not applicable.
